propositions: decision_flips comparison at parity.py:107 lacks an errored guard, scoring synthetic decisions from errored records as real model verdicts
a single transient error on one arm fails criterion (b) zero-flips gate as a fabricated regression when both sides should have agreed
the module contract at parity.py:46 documents errored as not a model verdict, yet parity.py:128 criterion (d) already gates error rate separately, making flip counting of errored pairs a double-count
three arms with identical real/error/flip compositions produce byte-identical gating strings, preventing readers from distinguishing real regressions from fabricated ones caused by transient errors
adding an errored guard to exclude both-side-errored pairs from decision_flips and surfacing them in a new errored_pairs metric resolves the contradiction and makes arms distinguishable
